title: NETSTREIT Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: NETSTREIT Corp. filed a Form 8-K on April 21, 2026 announcing the establishment of a new At-the-Market (ATM) equity offering program with an aggregate offering price of up to $400 million. The company entered into a sales agreement with multiple banks and dealers including Wells Fargo, BofA, Cantor, Jefferies and others to sell shares of its common stock (ticker: NTST) from time to time.
key_points: NETSTREIT Corp. established an At-the-Market offering program for up to $400 million in aggregate gross sales price of common stock
The company engaged 17 banks/dealers as sales agents, including Wells Fargo Securities, BofA Securities, Cantor Fitzgerald, Jefferies, and others
Sales agents may sell shares directly on NYSE, on other trading markets, through market makers, or in privately negotiated transactions with prior consent
The company may also enter into forward sale agreements with related forward purchasers and forward sellers
Sales agents will receive commissions not exceeding 1.5% of the gross sales price
The ATM offering will terminate upon the earlier of selling $400 million in shares or termination per the agreement terms
why_it_matters: This is a corporate equity issuance announcement and is not relevant to market structure or macro catalysts. ATM programs allow companies to gradually sell equity over time at prevailing market prices, providing flexible capital access. For NETSTREIT, this represents a potential source of share dilution that market participants may track.
